questions.question: Given: P causes Q; Q causes R and S; S causes T. List all downstream effects of P with confidence scores assuming 10% decay per hop.
Decompose 'serve dinner' into primitives. Available: prepare_meal (chop,cook), set_table (place_plates,place_cutlery), serve (bring_food).
Source: heart pumps blood through veins. Target domain: computer network. Map the analogy.
questions.expected_answer: Heart->router, blood->data packets, veins->cables. Router pushes packets through cables.

questions.question: Factual: John studied (S), passed (P), got job (J). Counterfactual: what if John had not studied?
questions.expected_answer: John would not pass; without passing he would not get the job. P and J would not occur.

questions.question: 2x2 minimax: Max at root. Left Min has leaves [3,5]. Right Min has leaves [2,9]. Optimal move and value?
questions.expected_answer: Left: Min picks 3. Right: Min picks 2. Max picks Left. Value=3.

questions.question: Time series: [50,51,49,52,50,48,95,51,50]. Identify anomalies using 3-sigma rule.
questions.expected_answer: t=7, value=95 is anomalous — significantly above the normal cluster mean of ~50.

questions.question: Solutions: X(quality=9,cost=8), Y(quality=6,cost=4), Z(quality=8,cost=7). Maximise quality, minimise cost. Find Pareto front.
questions.expected_answer: Pareto front: {X,Y}. Z is dominated by X.

questions.question: Observations: car won't start, lights don't work, radio silent. Rules: dead_battery->no_start, dead_battery->no_lights, dead_battery->no_radio, empty_fuel->no_start.
questions.expected_answer: H1: dead_battery (coverage=3/3, simple). Best explanation: dead battery.

questions.question: Tasks: A(priority=8,mean=4h,deadline=5h), B(priority=5,mean=6h,deadline=10h). Budget=1.0. Allocate to maximise expected utility.
questions.expected_answer: Allocate ~0.65 to A (tight deadline, high priority) and ~0.35 to B.
